reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives formalize the transition from qualitative feedback to actionable insights. They rely on probabilistic models to quantify uncertainty in user responses, enabling teams to prioritize features based on empirical evidence rather than subjective judgment. The key challenge is ensuring that the survey design respects the underlying data distribution to avoid biased estimates. By isolating individual components such as posterior calibration and coverage guarantees, we can systematically evaluate their performance and robustness.
